findings: Full-size 1672×941 composite inspected. Dark submerged cliffs, a visible water ceiling and cold directional water light distinguish this water arena; the horizontal lower fighting band remains continuous.

Targeted FAR removes the visible fish schools and isolated swimming silhouettes from the refused original. Targeted NEAR removes the tall kelp/side banks that covered the original fighting path. All original paintings are retained.

The NEAR is noticeably more cyan-green than the MID and produces a repeated, sharp horizontal ridge near the bottom. Small magenta edge flecks remain on side kelp after intake. These remain visual holds rather than accepted terrain.

This is an underwater interpretation of stormsea; it is not an above-surface rocky coast. Creature water containment, native parallax, effect readability and routing eligibility require independent review.
